result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 3, Article 3 (police permits for holistic health practitioners and tobacco/e-cigarette retailers), retrieved from a page whose URL suggests the algorithmic rent-price-fixing division but whose text contains no such provisions.
result.notes: This part contains only San Diego Municipal Code sections 33.4403-33.4409 (holistic health practitioner permits) and 33.4501-33.4505 (tobacco and electronic cigarette retailer permits). None concern rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees, tenant screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The URL and page title refer to a prohibition on algorithmic rent price fixing, but that text is not included in this part, so no rule is extracted.
